owner.heading: The guy who answers the phone

services.title: Concrete & Driveways
services.desc: Tear-outs, new pours, stamped patios, walkways and garage slabs. Proper base prep and control joints — so it doesn't crack like the last one did.

services.title: Landscaping & Hardscape
services.desc: Paver patios, retaining walls, planting beds, sod and gravel work. Yards that look intentional — and drain the right direction.

services.title: Kitchen & Bath Remodels
services.desc: Cabinets, counters, tile, fixtures and flooring — from a weekend refresh to a studs-out rebuild. One crew, one schedule, no mystery subs.

services.title: Decks & Fences
services.desc: Cedar, vinyl and composite. New builds, tear-out replacements and post repairs — set in concrete, square to the property line, built to shrug off Idaho winters.

services.title: Pressure Washing & Exterior Cleaning
services.desc: Driveways, siding, fences, patios and gutters. The fastest, cheapest way to make a house look five years newer before you spend a dime on anything else.

services.title: Handyman Punch-List
services.desc: That list on your fridge: sticking doors, drywall patches, leaning gates, caulk lines gone black. Send us the whole thing — we knock it out in one visit.

projects.title: Driveway replacement
projects.note: Tear-out to broom-finish in under a week on most driveways — old slab hauled off, new one cured, edges backfilled.

projects.title: Fence rebuild
projects.note: Old posts pulled, new ones set in concrete, boards restained to weather right — most backyard runs take two to three days.
